name: miraverseosx-root

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "dotnet run --project MiraverseOSx.csproj -- --server-only --port 5000" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "dotnet run --project MiraverseOSx.csproj -- --server-only --port 5000" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test:backend: node -e "import { spawnSync, execSync } from 'child_process'; let ps = 'powershell'; try { execSync('pwsh -v', { stdio: 'ignore' }); ps = 'pwsh'; } catch {} process.exit(spawnSync(ps, ['-NoProfile', '-File', 'scripts/test_backend_world.ps1'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:ai: node -e "import { spawnSync, execSync } from 'child_process'; let ps = 'powershell'; try { execSync('pwsh -v', { stdio: 'ignore' }); ps = 'pwsh'; } catch {} process.exit(spawnSync(ps, ['-NoProfile', '-File', 'scripts/test_backend_ai.ps1'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1);"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && dotnet build
scripts.test:case: python scripts/build_broad_street.py --check && python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_broad_street.py

description: MIRAVERSEOSX - Celestial Operating System Desktop Host
